name: New Era
verdict: US headwear company controlled by the founding Koch family, with ACON Investments a significant minority investor. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: New Era Cap, LLC is controlled by its founding Koch family (new-era-ownership; Reuters, 2024-06-06) with private-equity firm ACON Investments holding a significant stake; it completed the acquisition of '47 in August 2024. No state or state-fund owner, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company was found. Official Cap of LIV Golf and its 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners, checked 2026-10-03); shown as a partner on every LIV team page, including Ripper GC's (league deal recorded in data/deals/liv-new-era.json).
